args:
Ordinarily, I would have preferred to gather evidence and make the case

for your release using the proper channels of law.

Alas, the wheels of justice turn slowly, so if Cardinal Graht is making

his move during the Auspecalia, we don't have the luxury of time.

Given the circumstances, we have little

choice but to take extrajudicial measures.

Agreed. The day is already upon us,

and we haven't a second to lose.

Well, whatever we're doing, let's do it somewhere else.

This cell is cramping my wings something fierce.
Okay, does somebody want to tell me why there are there TWO Farises?!

Mmm? Oh, right. I guess this is your first time seeing it.

You can undo it now, Uriel.
Very well. I'll restore his customary form.

Wait, that's the little guy who's always on your shoulder.

He can turn INTO you?How did I not know this?

That ＂little guy＂ is a magical organism made with my mana.

And while it exists autonomously, I can choose to share its perceptions remotely if I wish.

And as it is a living wad of mana,

Uriel can make it take whatever shape he wants.
So the Faris that got caught with us back at Father Mugra's church was...

Exactly.

We had this little fellow take both my form and the fall.

I question giving your kid a surveillance pet as a parenting technique,

but I gotta admit it came in handy this time.

Your observation earns a failing grade.

It doesn't keep watch ON him, but OVER him.

Not sure you can actually split a hair that fine,

but whatever. What's the plan now?

We follow Regina's orders, obviously. Even though it's been some time

since she took command directly, she's not the sort to let her skills get rusty.

Then we'll be splitting up for now. It's been one dilly of an intermission,

but we're finally ready to kick off Act Two!

Yes, go wild. In the name of the Goddess,

it is time to administer Her will!

Our Sigils are presently sealed by some specialized device, which means we can't

use our powers. It's a serious pain in my... Well, it's a pain. Let's leave it at that.

So after Faris busts Ryszarda and the others out,

I'll be working to neutralize its effects and keep it from happening again.

I'm running an analysis with my tablet,

but it's going to take some time.

So meanwhile, I need you all to follow my instructions to redirect the enemy

and buy us some time. Here's the plan...

Grams

An Alley in the Slums
I don't see anything out of the ordinary.

Over there—it's an apostle and angel!

Those rats are trying to hide from us!
I didn't think the Templars would really come all this way!

Ha ha ha! There's only two of them—

they're no match for us!
One small correction, if I may.
Your assertion that you face only two foes is mistaken.

Just as Regina said. You know,

it's almost disturbing to see just how perfectly she's able to read their movements.

I always knew she was amazing,

but I have no idea how she does it.

Says the one with the freakishly accurate intuition.

Yes, well, let's finish up here and move on to the next spot.

You'll rue the day you underestimated a Templar!

Seize them!

Report, sir. Our men in the slums have engaged the apostles in combat

and are requesting immediate backup.

So those vipers are hoping to slip from our jurisdiction,

eh? Unless... Of course. That must be it.

Sir, a woman thought to be the apostles' leader was seen in the Third Cathedral.

Requesting reinforcements to capture her!

I knew it! The ones in the slums are but a diversion.

A clever gambit, but one we were able to unravel rather easily.

We make for the Third Cathedral at once.

We'll catch their commander unawares and put her in chains! All units, follow me!

...They're sticking to the script admirably.

Ten points awarded.

Faris passed with flying colors.

The main force of Templars has been successfully directed and will arrive shortly.

That lizard of yours really is handy.

Used correctly, such immediacy can turn the tides of a battle in an instant.

Yet like any tool,

it's not capable of garnering results beyond the wielder's imagination.

And if it did,

that would only be evidence that the user doesn't properly understand the tool....
Is that an allusion to Satan?

We know nothing of the Demonlord, save that it is a being of massive power.

How can anyone think to harness what they don't even understand?

I'm sure they see hope in the parts they can't yet know,

but that strikes me as the very height of madness.

I largely agree.

In which case, do you think we can stop that madness in time?

Thanks to your help, my analysis is nearly complete—

assuming we don't get any unexpected interruptions, that is.

I knew we'd find you foul traitors here.

Come to beg the Goddess's forgiveness?

...You make a fair point.

Might not be a bad idea to apologize to Her in advance.

Remorse? How surprising!

In that case, come quietly and—

Oh, sorry. Wasn't clear there. See, I'd be apologizing for what I'm ABOUT to do.

...You're up, Nevin!

Holy Goddess, grant me now the glory of thy name.

For so vast is thy mercy that the very earth buckles beneath its plenty!

Huh?! What's that shaking?!

No! The ground is giving way!

Drawing the enemy into a cathedral under construction only to

drop the floor out from under them? Such a sinful plan! Tsk tsk.

There's no worry of civilian injuries here, and they were already tearing it up.

What's a few more repairs, give or take?

Besides, ours is a merciful Goddess.

Make an apology donation or two and you can wriggle off the hook for just about anything.

Blasphemy, Regina! Or at least close to it!

...Also, you sounded like Nevin just now.

Looks like you're about finished here.

Hope I'm not late?
Right on schedule. Now it's just—

I'm here too. Running errands for my son took a bit longer than anticipated,

but I'm finally done.

Fine, though between the time they'll need to prepare and time spent on the road,

some degree of lag is unavoidable.

Still, that's everyone gathered, so let's check my analysis and... Hmm?

Strange. This Sigil response is distinct from that device's effects.

Gragh! You've gone and done it now!

I'll see you pay for your crimes!

He crawled back up with all that armor?

Someone's been working out.

It will take more than a cowardly trick like that to stop me!

Now witness the might and tenacity of the Templars!
How are there still so many of them?

We can't take on such numbers in our weakened condition.

...Regina? Analysis?

Complete, but I'm getting a new...

Never mind, I'll deal with that later. We're good. Sigil block...removed!

OH YEAAAAH! I feel like a whole new angel over here!

I'm surging with power!
It's true! Releasing my Sigil now!

Hold your ground, Templars!

We have the numbers, so strike as one!

content.content:
Following Regina's plan, the apostles and angels lure the Templars to a cathedral under renovation and take them out.
Finally, Regina analyzing and undoing the spell blocking their Sigils.
